question: Can all prescribed ritual procedures be completed at a single prepared peak as an alternative arrangement?
premises: Previous verses prescribe multiple possible ritual arrangements in the directions.
A single peak may be prepared as an alternative arrangement.
All prescribed ritual actions may be performed in that one place.
inference: Therefore, preparing one peak suffices as a valid location for performing all the prescribed ritual actions.
plain_english: Or, having prepared a single peak, one should perform everything there.
